lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits. The arrangement consists of multiple vertical columns where spot size and spacing appear relatively uniform, with a slight increase in inter-centroid distance moving posteriorly across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like network of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible along the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient (high-intensity upper edge transitioning to shadowed lower edge) extending from the post-cephalic region towards the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately eight companion fish (Echeneidae) is visible positioned ventrally beneath the left pectoral fin and along the lower abdomen.
